title: Cosmic Sorceress
description: A central female figure with flowing white hair and a multicolored galaxy dress stands in a swirling cosmic vortex, holding two glowing orbs. She is surrounded by zodiac symbols, floating orbs, silhouetted figures, and ethereal spirits against a starry nebula background.
prompt: A majestic sorceress with long flowing white hair stands at the center of a swirling cosmic vortex, wearing a dress made of colorful galaxies and nebulae in purple green and blue, holding a glowing orb in each hand, surrounded by floating zodiac symbols, fiery comets, starry orbs and ethereal spirits, dark silhouetted figures below, dramatic fantasy scene with swirling clouds and stars in the background
